missing_content: No rule for the 'not needing urgent attention' same-day referral triggers (pregnant, known bleeding disorder, anticoagulant, high-speed collision, ejected/hit by vehicle, fall > 3 m).
Fracture box 'Do x-ray and refer to doctor same day' and wound 'refer if...' criteria not encoded.
Vital-sign reassess thresholds (BP < 90/60, pulse > 100 or < 50, RR > 20 or < 9, SpO2 < 94%, GCS drop) are not encoded (management, arguably ok).
summary: Most consequential: the urgent head injury task includes mild headache and clouded consciousness (non-urgent concussion signs from outside the red box), and the injured-patient task includes shock criteria as conditions to check. Also dropped: vomiting >= 2 times threshold and muscle tightness in the fracture box; 'suspected' fractures are encoded as definite. The page's same-day-referral (non-urgent) triggers are not encoded at all.
